candidates.source_name: MIRRI SR – Plán obnovy a odolnosti (recovery plan section, Komponent 17 Digitálne Slovensko)
candidates.why_relevant: MIRRI is the implementing body for RRF Component 17 (Digitálne Slovensko). Its recovery-plan section publishes calls, milestones and project lists months before the corresponding tenders reach the public procurement journal, effectively pre-announcing which payment/e-government systems will be procured.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML crawl of /plan-obnovy/ and its /vyzvy/ subpages; diff new call pages; PDF extraction of annexes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language web search on recovery plan component 17
queries_used: Plán obnovy a odolnosti komponent 17 digitálne Slovensko projekty informatizácia zoznam

candidates.source_name: planobnovy.sk – official Recovery and Resilience Plan portal (full plan text + component pages)
candidates.why_relevant: Holds the complete RRP text and the 'Efektívna verejná správa a digitalizácia' component page, plus the methodological guide for IT in the RRP. Naming of planned systems here precedes tender publication by many months.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch and parse the component pages and the PDF assets under /site/assets/files/; monitor for new file IDs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search snowball from MIRRI
queries_used: Plán obnovy a odolnosti komponent 17 digitálne Slovensko projekty informatizácia zoznam

candidates.source_name: Eurofondy.gov.sk – Výzvy Programu Slovensko 2021–2027
candidates.why_relevant: Central listing of EU-funded calls, including measures 1.2.1/1.2.2/1.4.2/1.5.1 covering informatization, digital transformation and cybersecurity. Awarded grants convert into procurement by the beneficiary institutions, so this is a lead indicator of forthcoming IT/payments tenders.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the calls listing with filters on informatization measures; capture call ID, allocation, deadline, eligible beneficiaries.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on eurofondy IT calls
queries_used: MIRRI výzva eurofondy Program Slovensko informatizácia digitálna transformácia výzvy IT

candidates.source_name: MIRRI – Výzvy sekcie informatizácie (dotácie / IT calls)
candidates.why_relevant: Section-level call list of the informatization branch; smaller and faster-moving than the eurofondy portal and often the first place a planned system is named.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML listing scrape + diffing.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search
queries_used: MIRRI výzva eurofondy Program Slovensko informatizácia digitálna transformácia výzvy IT
local_language_terms_used: výzvy na predkladanie žiadostí o poskytnutie dotácie

candidates.source_name: MetaIS – Centrálny metainformačný systém verejnej správy (public register of state IT assets and projects)
candidates.why_relevant: The authoritative register of ISVS (public administration information systems), project records, feasibility studies, TCO and architecture. A new project record in MetaIS typically exists well before the tender notice; searching for payment-related ISVS reveals which institutions plan payment system work.
candidates.access_status: open (browsing); some detail pages may require session handling
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-driven crawl of the ISVS and project lists (Angular SPA — headless browser rather than plain HTTP); keyword filter on 'platob*', 'úhrad*', 'pokladn*'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search + snowball from MIRRI architecture pages
queries_used: MetaIS register projektov informatizácie verejnej správy metais.slovensko.sk projekt platobný
candidates.observed_blocker: Legacy host metais.vicepremier.gov.sk still appears in search results; the current portal is metais.slovensko.sk — treat old links as moved, not dead.

candidates.source_name: MIRRI – Verejné pripomienkovanie projektovej dokumentácie / štúdií uskutočniteľnosti
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory public consultation of project documentation and feasibility studies for state IT projects. Each notice names the planned system, scope, indicative budget and architecture — the single strongest pre-tender signal in the Slovak public sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the informatizácia news feed, filter titles containing 'verejné pripomienkovanie' / 'štúdi* uskutočniteľnosti' / 'projektov* dokumentáci*'; download attached PDFs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on public consultation of feasibility studies
queries_used: verejné pripomienkovanie projektovej dokumentácie štúdia uskutočniteľnosti MIRRI zoznam pripravovaných projektov

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financií SR – Útvar hodnoty za peniaze, hodnotenia investičných projektov (IT)
candidates.why_relevant: By law (523/2004 §19a) IT investments above ~EUR 10m must be economically assessed by ÚHP BEFORE public procurement starts. The published evaluation PDFs name the system, scope, cost model and expected procurement route — a legally guaranteed pre-tender artefact.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the hodnotenia listing and the /files/sk/financie/hodnota-za-peniaze/hodnotenia-investicnych-projektov/it/ directory; parse PDFs for system names, budgets and dates.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on value-for-money IT investment appraisal
queries_used: Útvar hodnoty za peniaze register investícií MF SR hodnotenie IT investícií verejné

candidates.source_name: MF SR – projektové zámery informatizácie (manažérske výstupy I-02, e.g. eFaktúra)
candidates.why_relevant: Concrete example of a published 'projektový zámer' for the eFaktúra (e-invoicing) project — a payments-adjacent state system. Such I-02 documents specify modules, integration points and indicative procurement lots long before tender.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Directory-pattern discovery of I-02/I-03 PDFs under the informatizácia folder; PDF text extraction.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on eFaktúra project plan
queries_used: Štátna pokladnica Finančná správa eFaktúra projekt plán digitalizácia platby verejná správa 2026

candidates.source_name: Slovensko.Digital – Red Flags (independent monitoring of state IT projects)
candidates.why_relevant: Civic watchdog that systematically tracks and rates state IT projects at the pre-procurement stage using a 50-criteria methodology. Excellent pointer/aggregator: it surfaces projects, links to their MetaIS records, feasibility studies and planned tenders, often earlier and more legibly than the state itself.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /projekty/<id> pages; extract project name, owner institution, budget, status and outbound links to source documents.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search on independent IT project ratings
queries_used: Slovensko.Digital hodnotenie IT projektov štátu red flag portál projekty

candidates.source_name: Slovensko.Digital – odporúčania k novým projektom a obstarávaniam (recommendation papers)
candidates.why_relevant: Position/recommendation documents on upcoming projects and procurements enumerate planned tenders and their contested points; useful for anticipating scope changes and delays.

candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Red Flags search

candidates.source_name: ITAPA – congress programme and partner listings (Jarná ITAPA / ITAPA Health & Care)

negative_findings.description: No single consolidated, machine-readable 'pipeline of upcoming public IT tenders' register was found for Slovakia. The pipeline has to be reconstructed by joining MetaIS project records, MIRRI public-consultation notices and MF SR/ÚHP ex-ante appraisals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Slovak for a consolidated list of prepared informatization projects returned only per-project consultation notices, not an aggregate register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must be multi-source and join-based; a single-feed assumption would miss most pre-tender signals.

negative_findings.description: No public vendor-day / supplier-day agendas published by individual Slovak banks (SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, 365.bank) were located in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only career pages and general conferences; bank-hosted supplier events appear to be invitation-only and unpublished.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the cell's hypothesised signal types (vendor days) is likely not observable via open web collection for commercial banks; the equivalent signal must be taken from third-party conferences and sponsor lists instead.

negative_findings.description: MetaIS project/ISVS detail pages were not fetched in this pass; the older host metais.vicepremier.gov.sk still appears in search indexes while the current portal is metais.slovensko.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results returned a legacy-host deep link; current-host reachability not tested here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Legacy links should be treated as moved (redirect/rewrite to the current host) rather than dead; a deterministic verification pass should resolve both hosts.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn job postings and LinkedIn company pages for Slovak banks and state agencies were not assessed as a collectable source in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the SBA LinkedIn company page appeared incidentally in results; no assessment of LinkedIn job-feed accessibility was made.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: LinkedIn carries many senior payments/vendor-management roles that never reach profesia.sk, but it is login-walled and ToS-restricted, so its status needs an explicit decision.

negative_findings.description: Local-language terminology for 'vendor day' / 'supplier day' in a banking context has no established Slovak equivalent; searches used English-in-Slovak forms only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No productive sk term identified beyond 'dodávateľský deň' (not attested in results).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This term family should be treated as untested rather than exhausted; future passes should try 'stretnutie s dodávateľmi', 'trhová konzultácia', 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' (the last is the legally defined pre-tender market consultation term).

coverage_gaps.description: Prípravné trhové konzultácie (statutory pre-tender market consultations under the Slovak public procurement act) were not searched; these are published by contracting authorities and are the most explicit legal pre-announcement of a tender.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' across uvo.gov.sk, institutional websites and the electronic procurement platform, and treat it as a direct pre-tender source.

coverage_gaps.description: State-sector payment-heavy institutions were not individually profiled: Štátna pokladnica, Sociálna poisťovňa, Slovenská pošta, VšZP, DataCentrum MF SR, NASES, Úrad vlády, self-governing regions and Bratislava/Košice city IT units.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an actor map with each institution's news feed, career page, budget documents and MetaIS records; these are the buyers whose weak signals matter most for payments.

coverage_gaps.description: Government legislative and cabinet pipelines (rokovania.gov.sk cabinet materials, slov-lex legislative process) were not covered; strategy documents and system mandates are approved there before any budget or tender exists.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add rokovania.gov.sk and slov-lex.sk keyword monitoring for payment/e-government system names.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-side strategy artefacts (annual reports, Pillar 3 disclosures, parent-group technology plans for Erste/Intesa/RBI/KBC) that name planned payment platform investments were not covered by this cell's pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add issuer/parent-group investor materials as an indirect pre-procurement signal for commercial-bank technology spend.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage in this cell was thin — most productive material is Slovak-only. EU-level sources (EU Recovery and Resilience Scoreboard country page, Digital Europe Programme work programmes) were only touched indirectly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run an EN pass on the EC RRF scoreboard for Slovakia and Digital Europe/CEF work programmes to capture the EU-side view of the same pipeline.

brief: Slovakia has an unusually rich set of legally mandated pre-tender artefacts: MIRRI publishes project documentation and feasibility studies for public comment, MF SR's Útvar hodnoty za peniaze must appraise IT investments above roughly EUR 10m before procurement starts, and MetaIS registers every state information system and project. Together with the Plán obnovy (Component 17) and Program Slovensko call pipelines, these name planned payment and e-government systems months to years before any award notice. Weak signals on the commercial-bank side are thinner: bank vendor days are not published, so job boards (profesia.sk, bank career pages) and third-party conference agendas — ITAPA above all, plus FinNext and NBS events — are the practical substitutes for reading which vendors and which institutions are converging. The highest-value next step is a dedicated pass on 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' and on the payment-heavy state buyers (Štátna pokladnica, Sociálna poisťovňa, Slovenská pošta, DataCentrum), which this cell did not profile.
